## Problem

Marisol at Riverbend is the only person who can move an appointment, so every swap between two therapists goes through her by text and then by spreadsheet.

## Appetite

Small — up to two weeks.

## Solution sketch

A read-only mobile view of the therapist's own week, plus a single "offer this slot to the team" action that pings the other therapists and lands in Marisol's queue for a one-tap confirm.

## Riskiest Assumptions & Cheap Validation Plan

1. **Claim:** Therapists will like the app enough to use it.
   **Threshold:** They keep using it.
   **Test:** Ask the therapists at Riverbend how they feel about it.
   **Timebox:** Two weeks.
